one_liner: The official add-on store for Cursor, the AI coding editor — ready-made skills like code review, teaching, and CI workflows.
buyer: Like most plugin directories, the real buyer is a plugin author seeking distribution, not a direct paying customer.
business_use_cases: A developer builds a niche Cursor plugin for a specific framework or industry and distributes it here for free adoption.
An engineering team studies the 'cursor-team-kit' plugin to standardize its own AI-assisted workflows.

steal_this: Package one of your team's repetitive review checklists as a free Cursor plugin this weekend to build credibility, then upsell a paid version.
